title: Stake
description: What one key moment means for one manager, computed by the points engine. Deterministic: the only source of numbers for the agents.

delta_points.description: Impact points this moment adds or removes, captain multiplier included.

reason_code.description: Which scoring rule fired, for example save_tier_reached.

milestone.description: Progress towards the next tier, for 'one more save' style lines.

above_threshold.description: True if this manager's agent should be called for this moment.

facts.description: What the moment means for this manager beyond the points (#87). Fact ids are unique within a stake, and every evidence id a fact cites is in this stake's evidence; the points engine guarantees both. rank_change is emitted only when the position changed.
